title: 3D店铺渲染图
prompt: Ultra-realistic 3D render of a cute, miniature [BRAND NAME] storefront building. Designed using the brand’s signature style and color palette. Features a clean, modern exterior with large glass windows and a glowing 3D [BRAND NAME] logo sign on the front. Includes subtle branded props inside the store. Background matches the brand’s identity — clean, relevant, and atmospheric. Slight isometric angle, warm lighting, soft shadows, and centered composition.
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro 模型，打造超写实3D迷你店铺渲染图，以简洁现代的建筑风格和温暖光影，完美呈现品牌标识与自然主题，适用于建筑品牌推广与logo可视化场景。
